name: Aito Momotani
source:
An everyday sudent who transfers to the academy this year, but for a normal human he arrives at a rather unusual time.
Aito is a really quiet and shy boy who has a different way of thinking than most people.
To boot, he is awfully clumsy and has heterochromia, which has always made him stand out.
Because of all that he has a history of being bullied.
[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1881950/Reimei_no_Gakuen__OtomeVisual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
